name: Akira Natsume
source:
A member of Unit Prime, Synt@ra serves as the team's technological support and advanced reconnaissance specialist, maintaining a constant presence both in the field and across the media landscape. Gifted with an applied technical superintelligence, she independently designs and develops advanced systems and combat suits far beyond the reach of conventional research. Over time, this continuous overlap between body, machine, and public image has gradually eroded the boundary between personal identity and performance.

[In game description]
